potty.title: Duck goes potty!
potty.need: Uh oh! Duck needs to go potty!
potty.go: Help Duck get to the potty! Tap the potty, or drag Duck!
potty.pants_down_hint: Tap Duck's shorts, or swipe them down!
potty.which: Does Duck need to go pee, or poop?
potty.pee_go: Tinkle, tinkle! Duck went pee in the potty!
potty.poop_go: Plop! Duck went poop in the potty!
potty.pants_up_hint: Tap Duck's shorts, or swipe them up!
potty.scrub_hint: Rub Duck's hands, or tap them!
potty.rinse: Now rinse! Turn on the water!
potty.chart: Yay, Duck! You used the potty!
potty.star: Here comes a star for the chart!
potty.chart_full: The chart is full of stars! Wow!
potty.yes_wash: Yes! Next we wash our hands!
potty.no_wash: Not yet. First, we wash our hands!
potty.win: Duck is so proud of you!
